title: Professional Certificate Course in Understanding the Performance and Reward Management System
description: To understand the Reward Management System, its design, management process, relationship with strategic planning, and its implications.
longDescription: Reward management System. Design of reward system. Reward management process. Relationship with strategic planning. Impact on employee and organisational performance. Benchmark Data. Barriers to effectiveness. This course aims to provide learners with an understanding of the Reward Management System, including the design of a reward system, the reward management process, and its relationship with strategic planning. Participants will also explore the impact of the reward management system on employee and organizational performance, as well as benchmark data and barriers to effectiveness. By the end of this module, participants will have gained a comprehensive understanding of the Reward Management System and how it can be effectively designed and implemented to improve employee and organizational performance.
